# JNB Events

> Premium Asian wedding and event décor, mandaps, DJ, dance floors, lighting, and special effects based in Leicester and covering Leicestershire, the Midlands, London, and nationwide across the UK.

## Overview
JNB Events (also known as JNB Sounds & Events) is an established event styling and entertainment company based in Leicester, England. We provide bespoke wedding styling, traditional carved and modern gold mandap hire, civil ceremony setups, reception decor, professional Asian wedding DJs, LED dance floors, indoor cold spark machines, and dry ice low fog ("dancing on clouds") effects.

- **Website:** https://jnbevents.co.uk/
- **Location:** Leicester, Leicestershire, United Kingdom
- **Service Areas:** Leicester, Leicestershire, Birmingham, Coventry, Nottingham, Derby, East Midlands, West Midlands, London, Yorkshire, Manchester, North West, and nationwide across the UK.
- **Telephone / WhatsApp:** +44 7872 340258 (07872 340258)
- **Email:** contact@jnbevents.co.uk
- **Languages:** English, Gujarati, Hindi

## Core Services

### 1. Mandaps & Stages
- Traditional carved wooden mandaps and contemporary gold geometric mandaps for Hindu and Asian wedding ceremonies.
- Packages include 4 choris, 2 bajots, 2 patlas, 6 ceremony chairs, havan kund, Ganesh statue for foyer, entrance gate, pleated backdrops, and ceremony carpet.
- URL: https://jnbevents.co.uk/services/mandaps-and-stages/

### 2. Wedding Décor & Venue Styling
- Complete venue styling, sweetheart tables, backdrops, foyer welcome setups, aisle décor, and drapery tailored to your colours and venue.
- URL: https://jnbevents.co.uk/services/decor/

### 3. Civil Ceremony Décor
- Elegant ceremony backdrops, aisle floral pillars, chiavari chair styling, registry table dressing, and entrance styling for civil marriages and partnerships.
- URL: https://jnbevents.co.uk/services/civil-ceremony-decor/

### 4. DJ & Entertainment
- Professional Asian wedding DJs and sound production mixing Bollywood, Bhangra, Urban, R&B, and commercial chart hits with crystal-clear audio and intelligent lighting.
- URL: https://jnbevents.co.uk/services/dj-and-entertainment/

### 5. Reception Décor & Centrepieces
- Tall and low floral centrepieces, luxury candelabras, charger plates, top table styling, mood lighting, and table dressing for evening receptions.
- URL: https://jnbevents.co.uk/services/reception-decor-centrepieces/

### 6. Haldi & Mehndi Décor
- Vibrant yellow, orange, and marigold styling, traditional jhoolas (swings), low seating cushions, backdrops, and colourful props for pre-wedding ceremonies at homes or venues.
- URL: https://jnbevents.co.uk/services/haldi-and-mehndi-decor/

### 7. Sparklers & Low Fog (Special Effects)
- Non-pyrotechnic indoor cold spark machines (safe, no smoke or flame) and genuine dry ice low fog for the iconic "dancing on clouds" first dance experience. Operated by trained technicians with full risk assessments.
- URL: https://jnbevents.co.uk/services/sparklers-smoke-effects/

### 8. LED Dance Floor & Event Lighting
- White gloss LED starlit dance floors, wireless RGB venue uplighting, festoon lighting, pin-spot lighting, and illuminated backdrops.
- URL: https://jnbevents.co.uk/services/dance-floor-and-lighting/

### 9. Outdoor & House Lighting
- Architectural festoon and fairy lighting for houses, marquees, gardens, and shopfronts for Diwali, weddings, and celebrations.
- URL: https://jnbevents.co.uk/services/outdoor-lighting/

### 10. Complete Bespoke Packages
- Combined décor and entertainment packages delivering unified styling, seamless on-day coordination, and cost savings under one team.
- URL: https://jnbevents.co.uk/services/packages/

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Where does JNB Events operate?
Based in Leicester, covering Leicestershire, Birmingham, the East and West Midlands, London, Yorkshire, the North West, and travelling across the UK for destination events.

### Do you style Hindu, Sikh, Muslim, and Civil weddings?
Yes. Our team styles Asian, Hindu, Sikh, Muslim, civil, and multicultural weddings with deep respect for ceremonial traditions and customs.

### Are indoor cold sparklers and dry ice fog safe?
Yes. Cold spark machines produce no heat, flame, or burning smell, and dry ice fog stays hugging the floor without setting off optical venue smoke detectors. Full risk assessments and public liability insurance are in place.

### How do clients book or enquire?
Clients can contact JNB Events via WhatsApp on +44 7872 340258, via the contact form at https://jnbevents.co.uk/contact/, or by emailing contact@jnbevents.co.uk.
